newsitem.title: FRANCE: French shares open higher, then decline slightly.
newsitem.headline: French shares open higher, then decline slightly.

text.p: French shares opened higher, supported by the dollar and Wall Street, but slipped after a few minutes to below the 3,000 level.
Dealers said there was profit-taking on the last day of the July Bourse account. On Friday, Usinor will enter into the CAC-40 index, replacing Suez which merger with Lyonnaise des Eaux.
*CAC-40 index down 2.43, or 0.08 percent, at 3,001.1 at 0807 GMT.
* CAC-40 July futures 3,010 vs 3,012 at Wednesdays close.

* Elf, down 0.15 percent at 677 francs, said it planned to sell its remaining stake in Renault of some 1.2 percent. On Wednesday the European Union said it would start a probe into subsidies paid for the German Leuna refinery.

* Rhone-Poulenc,down 2.22 percent at 246.30, set to report its first half results on Friday. Rhone-Poulenc Rorer, in which it has 68 percent, reported lower than expected first half profits of $0.98 per share.
